definitions.explanation: Favoring traditional values, methods, or practices; resistant to change.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保守的|ほしゅてき}な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He has a conservative way of thinking.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保守的|ほしゅてき}な⟦{風土|ふうど}→風土：14628_fuudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This region has a conservative character.

examples.japanese: {保守的|ほしゅてき}な⟦{見積|みつ}もり→見積もり：05153_mitsumori⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧{100万円|ひゃくまんえん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Even by conservative estimates, it will cost at least one million yen.
examples.notes: Uses the meaning 'cautious, on the safe side'

notes:
FORMS:
- Adverbial: {保守的|ほしゅてき}に (conservatively)
- Noun: ⟦{保守|ほしゅ}→保守：19090_hoshu⟧ (conservatism, maintenance)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {保守的|ほしゅてき}な⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧／⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ (conservative thinking/opinion)
- {保守的|ほしゅてき}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ (conservative stance)
- {保守的|ほしゅてき}な⟦{見積|みつ}もり→見積もり：05153_mitsumori⟧ (conservative estimate)

USAGE: Can refer to:
- Political conservatism
- Traditional/unchanging attitudes
- Cautious or safe estimates

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧: Traditional (neutral, about customs)
- {保守的|ほしゅてき}: Conservative (implies resistance to change)
